data: How do I sell a broken car to someone?

You should try to get an appraisal from a car dealership to determine the current market value of the car before attempting to sell it. You should also make sure that the car is registered and that all paperwork is in order before attempting to sell it. Additionally, it might be beneficial to include photos of the car when listing it for sale to provide potential buyers with a better idea of the condition.
